note: Verification log. One row per claim that had to be checked to build or review this repository. Method is reproducible as described; verdicts were recorded on 2026-11-13 by reading the cited page, not from recollection. UNVERIFIED rows stay blank on the site.

rows.method: measured each supplied token (9/9/9 chars) and confirmed the lookup contract requires an item identifier accepted by the catalog API

rows.subject: Product attributes
rows.claim: title / brand / category / price / rating / availability for the three items
rows.method: requires an authenticated catalog lookup (Creators API GetItems) with credentials that do not exist in this workspace

rows.subject: Disclosure wording
rows.claim: Sites must clearly and prominently state "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
rows.method: read Operating Agreement Sec. 5
rows.consequence: R-01; sentence rendered on every content page

rows.subject: Enforcement
rows.claim: breach of Sec. 5 / Program Policies is a material breach and can end commission income
rows.method: read Operating Agreement Sec. 2 and Sec. 6

rows.subject: Attribution
rows.claim: Session = 24h from click (or first order / another associate's click); cart path 89 days; ship+pay within 180 days
rows.method: read Program Policies - Commission Income Statement Sec. 1

rows.subject: Commission rates
rows.method: transcribed the published table row by row

rows.subject: Bounties
rows.claim: Prime free trial / paid membership $12.00, Prime Video free trial $2.00, first stream $5.00, stream $0.25
rows.method: read the Special Commission Income bounties table
rows.consequence: bounty rows on the commissions page

rows.subject: Payment terms
rows.claim: paid ~60 days after month end; US minimums 10 USD deposit / 10 USD gift card (2000 USD max) / 100 USD check with 15 USD fee
rows.method: read Commission Income Statement Sec. 6 and the Payment Minimum Chart

rows.subject: Price display
rows.claim: prices/availability may be shown only via an Amazon-served link or Creators/PA API data under the License; comparison pages must show the lowest new (and, if provided, used) price
rows.method: read Participation Requirements Sec. 2(b)

rows.subject: Tagging and sub-tags
rows.claim: Special Links must carry the Associates tag; sub-tags may not be associated with a specific end user
rows.method: read Participation Requirements Sec. 2(b)

rows.subject: Naming
rows.claim: no Amazon trademark or variant in any domain, subdomain, tag, or social identifier
rows.method: read Participation Requirements Sec. 1 unsuitable-site list item (g)
rows.consequence: R-11; site named Northstar; build-time scan

rows.subject: Offline promotion
rows.claim: Content / marks / Special Links may not be used in print, mail, SMS, MMS, email or attachments, or oral solicitation
rows.method: read Participation Requirements Req. 6
rows.consequence: R-09; email/SMS channels removed from the campaign schema

rows.subject: Content integrity
rows.claim: Content may not be altered (e.g. no inserting words into a customer review) nor sold, resold, redistributed, sublicensed or transferred
rows.method: read Participation Requirements Reqs. 8 and 9

rows.subject: Double claiming
rows.claim: tags may only be used to benefit from Associates commissions; combining attribution with another program on the same traffic can forfeit commissions
rows.method: read Commission Income Statement Sec. 5

rows.subject: API status
rows.claim: PA-API 5.0 is deprecated; calls return 403 AccessDenied and integrators must migrate to the Creators API
rows.method: fetched the legacy PA-API documentation URL; it now serves Amazon's deprecation notice

rows.subject: API prerequisites
rows.claim: Creators API requires Associates enrolment, >=10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days, registration in Associates Central, and generated credentials
rows.method: read the official Creators API introduction
rows.consequence: collector raises BLOCKED instead of scraping

rows.subject: FTC disclosure mechanics
rows.claim: material connection must be clear and conspicuous; "paid link" next to the link can be adequate, "commissionable link" is not, and a disclosure in a comment section is not conspicuous
rows.method: read FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking

rows.subject: Amazon's own disclosure FAQ
rows.claim: link-level disclosure must be clear (e.g. "(paid link)", "#ad", "#CommissionsEarned") and conspicuous, and made in the same medium as the recommendation
rows.method: read the Associates help topic on identifying yourself as an Associate

rows.subject: Affiliate link markup
rows.claim: affiliate links should be qualified with rel="sponsored"; failing to do so risks manual and algorithmic action
rows.method: read Google Search Central link-qualification docs and the 2021 blog post
rows.consequence: R-17; builder always emits rel="sponsored nofollow"

rows.subject: Structured data
rows.claim: Product/Review markup supports pros and cons via positiveNotes/negativeNotes whose text must match the visible page; review author must be a valid Person/Team name; promotional strings such as "50% off on Black Friday" are not recommended
rows.method: read Google's merchant-listing docs and the pros-and-cons announcement

rows.subject: Earnings expectation
rows.claim: Amazon makes no representation about the traffic or commission income an associate can expect
rows.method: read Operating Agreement Sec. 4
